You can expect rain for roughly half of the month of November in Bali. We’re expecting roughly 8 to 15 days of rain, so your rubber boots and umbrella are going to see plenty of use this month if you’re keen on staying dry.

Our weather forecast can give you a great sense of what weather to expect in Bali in November 2026.

If you’re planning to visit Bali in the near future, we highly recommend that you review the 14 day weather forecast for Bali before you arrive.

## Weather overview and FAQs

### Weather overview

In Bali in November, the average air temperature ranges from 32 °C (89 °F) during the day to 23 °C (73 °F) at night. There are 13 days of rain on average, where the rainfall is 146 mm (5.74 in).

### Is November a good month to visit Bali? [...] In November in Bali, there are ideal conditions for a vacation. The temperature during the day will be nice 32 °C (89 °F). The seawater temperature reaches ideal 28 °C (83 °F). At night, temperatures hover around a pleasant 23 °C (73 °F).

### What is the sea temperature in Bali in November?

The temperature of the sea in Bali in November is 28 °C (83 °F). This temperature is someone's dream come true, while for someone it may no longer be ideal for the purpose of refreshment. [...] ### What temperature can I expect during the day in Bali in November?

In Bali in November, the average daily temperatures will be 32 °C (89 °F). The great temperature for lying by the sea or pool and sunbathing, everywhere else you will probably be a bit hot. Don't forget to drink during the day, in these temperatures you should hydrate yourself a lot.
